newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton crop seen more than 9 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton crop seen more than 9 mln bales.

text.p: An official committee assessing Pakistan's 1996/97 (July-June) cotton crop said on Sunday the crop size would be more than nine million 375-lb bales.

"The consensus at the meeting was that the crop will positively be more than nine million bales," Zahoor Ahmed, director of the state Central Cotton Research Institute, told Reuters after the meeting in the city of Multan in Punjab province.

He said the committee of officials and representatives of farmers, ginners and spinners, had maintained last month's estimate of 9.2 million to 9.5 million bales, down from a target of 10 million bales and the 1995/96 crop 9.96 million bales.
"The participants were more confident of their estimates," Ahmed said.
He said present weather conditions were favourable to the crop, but chances of production above the committee's estimate were limited due to pest attack in September and October.
